title: Multimodal spatio-temporal deep learning approach for neonatal postoperative pain assessment
summary: A multimodal spatio-temporal deep-learning model combined visual and vocal signals to estimate neonatal postoperative pain, reporting AUC 0.87 and accuracy 79% on a real-world dataset. The small study and shared behavioral reference limit interpretation; clinical outcomes were not evaluated.
